title: Jesus! Name of Wondrous Love
description: Jesus! Name of Wondrous Love in Tonic Solfa to VIENNA, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 6 verses and a piano.
about: William Walsham How wrote these words. They were printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (St. Louis, 1927), as hymn 178.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Sevens (7.7.7.7), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to VIENNA; any other Sevens tune fits them as well.
underlay: Je-sus! Name of won-drous love, Name all oth-er names a-bove, Un-to which must ev-ery knee Bow in deep hu-mil-i-ty.

lines: To the fallen sons of earth,
For the promise that it gave,—
When the cup of human woe
Bursts his fetters and is saved.
Helpless, O our God, to Thee.

licence: Public domain: William Walsham How died in 1897.
credits: Words by William Walsham How (1823–1897), public domain, as printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (1927); set to VIENNA by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
